claim.summary: Surface resources mount atomically, start and refresh from exact snapshots, validate Catalog inputs and outputs, contain technical failures, ignore stale settlements, and dispose terminally.

semantics.mountPublication: atomic frozen idle generation without host calls
semantics.resourceSnapshotAuthority: exact current manager-issued object identity; stale, foreign, and ABA-equal views rejected
semantics.resolutionSnapshotAuthority: factory-authenticated snapshot whose resource namespace equals the manager snapshot
semantics.compositorPrecondition: same-turn provenance for state, context, operation, event, item, and env is trusted until M04-T16
semantics.initialBatch: canonical instance order from one exact current manager snapshot
semantics.inputBoundary: one M04-T03 synthetic-array materialization and token cache, reconstruction, then exact resource-input schema validation
semantics.candidateIdentity: visible to token lookup but consumed only after complete accepted input preparation
semantics.outputBoundary: exact resource-output schema validation, redacted frozen diagnostics, then detached bounded lifecycle publication
semantics.publicFailure: exact declared Catalog error code only

finiteLimits.hostProfile: may lower but never raise finite ceilings
finiteLimits.snapshotCapacity: terminal transition reserved before request acceptance
finiteLimits.queue: canonical promotion with queued same-instance replacement

semantics.hostCallbacks: resource, token, and diagnostic callbacks invoked without a receiver
semantics.disposal: terminal, idempotent, clears retained records and queue, replaces handle authority with sentinel
